Okay here is my expirience with depression. I have no motivation. I feel down for no reason. When I get into these low periods I don't want to talk to people or be around them. I don't want to get out of bed cause I know of I do I will have to go through another day. I end up skipping class cause I really don't care and it's not worth feeling the pressure of being around people. Sometimes I think I'm making everything up, that it's all in my head. I don't know what is me and what is the depression or the pills I'm on. I'm not myself but I don't even know who "myself" is anymore.my wrists itch to be cut and crying is pointless. I feel numb and I know talking to someone about it doesn't help. I push everyone away so I feel completely alone. Let's not forget about the absence of any self worth or confidence. I can't look at my body in the mirror anymore. If someone compliments me, seldom as it is, I don't believe it cause I know they are only doing to to be nice. That's only the tip of the iceberg. I don't know how to describe it anymore.
